flags.message: The petition asks to be held for Robinhood Markets v. Sodha (No. 25-944), which carries a CVSG and an SG grant recommendation and is set for the same conference. The docket has no Vide link to it, so record/related/ staged nothing, and the forecast hinges on it. I read the companion's state from the live supremecourt.gov docket and the corpus --docket-number lookup instead.
